Notes: Freelancers Inc. Agency Receptionist (Rome Blue / Old Athen). Points players to Handler / Senior / Alien desks. Stand-in.

hello.Text: Freelancers Inc. Mission Agency. Sign the contract at the desk, then speak to the Handler for Rubi-Ka dailies, the Senior Handler for elite work, or the Alien Handler for AXP contracts. There is no waiting period between contracts.

work.Text: I stamp the paperwork. The Handlers issue the actual missions. No lock-out between contracts.
